**Finding: compliant** (RENEWAL — auto-renewal and non-renewal notice window)

- The only term-renewing element is maintenance under § 10, which is "a renewable one-year term" — a 12-month, non-automatic renewal with no non-renewal notice window and no multi-year auto-renewal, so nothing locks us in.
- The licence is perpetual while fees are paid (§ 17(a)) and we hold a broad at-will termination right on 90 days' notice (§ 17(b)), so exit is straightforward.
- This sits at the preferred position; no redline proposed. Noted in the rationale only: no vendor renewal reminder and no express CPI/3% cap on maintenance fee uplift (fees follow the Fee Schedule) — worth pursuing commercially if the Fee Schedule lets Garman reset renewal pricing.
